 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Exhilerate'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Exhilarate'.**
 
• The word '**Exhilarate**' is a **verb** which means 'make (someone) feel very happy, animated, or elated'. **(उत्साहित करना)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• The breathtaking view from the top of the mountain is sure to exhilarate you.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'Exhilerate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Incorrigible -** not able to be corrected, improved, or reformed **(असुधारनीय)**
 
• **Mischievous - **causing or showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful way **(शरारती)**
 
• **Amendment -** a minor change or addition designed to improve a text, piece of legislation, etc **(संशोधन)**
